Name: Instant Grow Trees
Author: cantorsdust
Description:
This mod makes trees grow instantly overnight if they have enough space.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Use[/size]
All tree saplings and seeds will now grow instantly overnight if they have enough space around them. You can [url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/blob/master/InstantGrowTrees#configure]optionally configure how the mod works[/url], including whether fruit trees should instantly age to iridium quality (disabled by default).

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single-player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[*]May conflict with A Tapper's Dream. No other known mod conflicts.
[/list]

[/list]
